title: A Study to Evaluate the Use and Safety of CARDIOLITE® in Pediatric Patients With Kawasaki Disease
brief_summary: Determine the predictive value of CARDIOLITE® rest and stress myocardial perfusion imaging (MPI) to define a pediatric population with Kawasaki Disease (KD) at high and low risk of developing cardiac events.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Males or females between 4 and 16
* Meet the epidemiological definition of Kawasaki Disease or have a diagnosis of incomplete KD, including evidence of coronary artery disease as determined by their physician.
* Be able to exercise adequately to achieve 85% age predicted maximum heart rate

Exclusion Criteria:

* Terminal illness where expected survival is \< 6 months
